package main

import (
    "crypto/tls"
    "crypto/x509"
    "encoding/json"
    "encoding/pem"
    "errors"
    "fmt"
    "os"
    "time"

    "github.com/Joker20380/family_connect/carrier/familysession"
)

func check() error {
    if len(os.Args) != 3 { return errors.New("arguments") }
    raw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
    if err != nil { return err }
    configuration, expiry, err := familysession.Configuration(raw, true)
    if err != nil || !expiry.After(time.Now()) { return errors.New("configuration") }
    var credentials familysession.Credentials
    if json.Unmarshal(raw, &credentials) != nil { return errors.New("credentials") }
    canaryRaw, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
    if err != nil { return err }
    block, remaining := pem.Decode(canaryRaw)
    if block == nil || len(remaining) != 0 { return errors.New("certificate") }
    canary, err := x509.ParseCertificate(block.Bytes)
    if err != nil { return err }
    chains, err := canary.Verify(x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: configuration.ClientCAs, KeyUsages: []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageClientAuth}})
    if err != nil { return err }
    state := tls.ConnectionState{Version: tls.VersionTLS13, NegotiatedProtocol: familysession.Protocol, PeerCertificates: []*x509.Certificate{canary}, VerifiedChains: chains}
    if configuration.VerifyConnection(state) != nil { return errors.New("canary admission") }
    gateway, err := x509.ParseCertificate(configuration.Certificates[0].Certificate[0])
    if err != nil { return err }
    gatewayChains, err := gateway.Verify(x509.VerifyOptions{Roots: configuration.RootCAs, DNSName: "gateway.family-connect.test", KeyUsages: []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth}})
    if err != nil { return err }
    client, _, err := familysession.Configuration(raw, false)
    if err != nil || client.VerifyConnection(tls.ConnectionState{Version: tls.VersionTLS13, NegotiatedProtocol: familysession.Protocol, PeerCertificates: []*x509.Certificate{gateway}, VerifiedChains: gatewayChains}) != nil { return errors.New("gateway binding") }
    for _, mutation := range []string{"family", "revision", "crl"} {
        changed := credentials
        switch mutation {
        case "family": changed.Family = "00000000000000000000000000000000"
        case "revision": changed.MinimumRevision++
        case "crl": changed.MinimumCRL++
        }
        encoded, _ := json.Marshal(changed)
        altered, _, failure := familysession.Configuration(encoded, true)
        if failure == nil && altered.VerifyConnection(state) == nil { return errors.New("negative admission") }
    }
    fmt.Println("native_gateway_and_canary_certificates=PASS family_revision_crl_negatives=PASS effective_expiry=" + expiry.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
    return nil
}

func main() {
    if check() != nil {
        fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "offline native validation failed; details suppressed")
        os.Exit(1)
    }
}
